name: dynamodbstreams
description: Amazon DynamoDB Amazon DynamoDB Streams provides API actions for accessing streams and processing stream records.

subcommands.name: describe-stream
subcommands.description: Returns information about a stream, including the current status of the stream, its Amazon Resource Name (ARN), the composition of its shards, and its corresponding DynamoDB table.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the stream

options.name: --limit
options.description: The maximum number of shard objects to return.

options.name: --exclusive-start-shard-id
options.description: The shard ID of the first item that this operation will evaluate.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-records
subcommands.description: Retrieves the stream records from a given shard.

options.name: --shard-iterator
options.description: A shard iterator that was retrieved from a previous GetShardIterator operation.

options.name: --limit
options.description: The maximum number of records to return from the shard.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

options.name: --stream-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the stream

options.name: --shard-id
options.description: The identifier of the shard.

options.name: --shard-iterator-type
options.description: Determines how the shard iterator is used to start reading stream records from the shard: AT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER - Start reading exactly from the position denoted by a specific sequence number.

options.name: --sequence-number
options.description: The sequence number of a stream record in the shard from which to start reading

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: list-streams
subcommands.description: Returns an array of stream ARNs associated with the current account and endpoint.

options.name: --table-name
options.description: If this parameter is provided, then only the streams associated with this table name are returned

options.name: --limit
options.description: The maximum number of streams to return.

options.name: --exclusive-start-stream-arn
options.description: The ARN (Amazon Resource Name) of the first item that this operation will evaluate.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
